onboarding.removeBody: Only the hook entries Agent Pets wrote are removed. Your own settings and other hooks stay, and the shared hook script is kept while another tool still uses it.
onboarding.removeDone: Agent Pets integration removed. Your other settings were left as they were.
onboarding.cleanupBody: This removes all agent hooks and plugins, the shared hook script, connection tokens and the files in ~/.desktop-pet. Your own settings and other hooks stay. The pet will stay offline until you reinstall.
onboarding.cleanupDone: Cleanup finished. Run this before uninstalling the app.
